current_evidence: The ECC minerals, waste and county council planning page still links the Regulation 3, Minerals and Waste validation lists, all dated March 2025 on their covers, and a search turned up nothing newer.

issues.detail: About 40 requirements from the Regulation 3 (county council's own development) list are filed under 'Full planning', with the note 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning'. Meanwhile 'County own devt (Reg 3)' is marked '(none) national requirements only'. ECC does not determine ordinary full applications: the list states that residential and commercial applications go to the district councils. Examples: Air Quality Assessment, Archaeological Assessment, Construction Management Plan, Parking Provision, Planning Statement. All of these belong under County own devt (Reg 3) and, via the Minerals and Waste lists, under Minerals & waste.
issues.evidence: Reg 3 list: 'Regulation 3 applications: ECC's own development, including new schools...'; residential/commercial applications go to the district, borough or city council

issues.detail: Under 'Minerals & waste (county)', only 4 rows were captured. Missing minerals/waste-specific requirements: Borehole or Trial Pit Analysis (all mineral extraction applications); Phasing Plans / Proposed Scheme of Working (operations proposed in phases); Water Resources Assessment (new minerals development or extensions with non-domestic water demand over 20,000 litres/day); Dust Assessment (mineral extraction and waste management; currently misfiled under Full planning); Agricultural Justification Statement (new agricultural reservoirs with mineral export; misfiled under Full planning); Agricultural Land Classification and Soil Assessment (BMV land Grades 1, 2, 3a).

Local requirements in the Reg 3 list with no row: Airport Safeguarding Statement (within aerodrome consultation areas: tall structures >90m, reflective structures, lighting, bird risk); External Materials Board (new built development); Green Belt Statement (all applications in the Green Belt); Public Rights of Way (any application affecting a PRoW); HRA for Epping Forest SAC (possible impact on the SAC); Annex 1 Essex Housing: Accessibility Assessment (new residential) and Sustainability Assessment.

Several triggers are truncated or misstate the threshold. Air Quality Assessment gives only 'Major development', but the source also covers substantial earthworks/demolition, dust/traffic impacts and development within 1km of an AQMA. Biodiversity Checklist gives only 'major8 development' (footnote digit left in), but the source also covers SSSI Impact Risk Zones, land within 100m of nature reserves or local wildlife sites, and protected species. The CIL row runs into the Contaminated Land text and omits the trigger (adopted CIL area with net new floorspace of 100m2 or more).
issues.evidence: Reg 3 list: AQA trigger list; CIL 'net new floorspace is 100m2 or more'

issues.detail: Rows where the trigger text is not the requirement's own. BNG and Design and Access Statement carry contents-page text ('Page 14-15 Biodiversity Net Gain Statement Page 16 8 Planning Application Forms...'). 'Schedule of works (listed building)' carries ecology mitigation text; no such requirement exists in the list. 'Environmental Statement (EIA)' carries pre-application/online submission text instead of the trigger (Schedule 1 or 2 development likely to have significant effects). 'Ground investigation / Basement Impact Assessment' is actually the Hydrology/Hydrogeology Assessment (dewatering). 'Waste / Refuse' carries a dust fragment. 'Transport Assessment' under Listed building consent carries the Heritage Statement text.
issues.evidence: Reg 3 list Environmental Statement p.40; Minerals list item 29 Hydrology/Hydrogeology Assessment

issues.detail: Flood Risk Assessment, Sequential/Exception Test and Block plan are placed under 'Change of use - prior approval', apparently because the FRA trigger mentions 'change of use'. ECC's lists do not cover prior approvals. Transport Assessment is placed under Listed building consent with no basis.
issues.evidence: FRA trigger: 'Flood Zones 2 or 3 (including minor development and changes of use)'

issues.detail: Tab items under 'Submission rules' and 'Local forms' are process text, not requirements: 'Keep individual file sizes small', 'Firewall restrictions limit ... 10MB', submitting on USB, 'The Council does not provide paper copies', 'Planning Application fees are set nationally', 'All sections of the checklist should be completed'. The 'Pre-application advice / engagement details' row is advisory text, not a requirement.

The fee text appears three times, once from each of the Reg 3, Minerals and Waste lists. Floor plans/Elevations and Roof plan triggers repeat across the three lists, and HRA appears under both Full planning and Minerals & waste with different trigger wording.
The Date basis is the URL upload month. The documents themselves state 'March 2025' on the cover, so the date is right, but it should be sourced from the document text.

summary: The link and date are correct and current (the March 2025 Reg 3 list, with matching Minerals and Waste lists). Most county requirements were filed under 'Full planning' while the 'County own devt (Reg 3)' and most 'Minerals & waste' rows were left empty, so several minerals-specific and Reg 3 items are missing and many triggers are truncated.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
